subject: Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineering Intern Interest, OrthoIQ
body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I saw the Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineering Intern opening at OrthoIQ and wanted to reach out directly, since a CTO overseeing embedded electronics and firmware for surgical hardware is exactly the kind of technical lead I would want to learn from.

Most of my recent work sits right in that space. I wrote bare metal C firmware for an ARM microcontroller, handling GPIO, timers, ADC, and I2C peripherals at the register level. I also built a tracking system combining servo motor control, FreeRTOS task coordination, and UART commands between a microcontroller and a Jetson board, along with time of flight sensor integration for range feedback. Earlier on I designed and fabricated my own circuit boards in EAGLE with working sensor communication.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
hook_used: Title relevance, CTO directly owns the embedded and firmware domain the intern role sits under, full technical depth per engineer calibration
